verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              तत्प्रभग्नं बलं दृष्ट्वा मद्रराजः प्रतापवान्। उवाच सारथिं तूर्णं चोदयाश्वान्महाजवान्॥१॥
एष तिष्ठति वै राजा पाण्डुपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। छत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन पाण्डुरेण विराजता॥२॥
verses.english: There stands king Yudhishthira, the son of Pandu, shining with the uinbrella held over his head.

verses.sanskrit: अत्र मां प्रापय क्षिप्रं पश्य मे सारथे बलम्। न समर्थो हि मे पार्थः स्थातुमद्य पुरो युधि॥३॥
verses.english: Reach me there quickly driver and witness my power. The Parthas are unable to stand before me in battle."

verses.sanskrit: एवमुक्तस्ततः प्रायान्मद्रराजस्य सारथिः। यत्र राजा सत्यसन्धो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥४॥
verses.english: Thus addressed the driver, of the Madra king, proceeded where stood the righteous king Yudhishthira of sure aim.

verses.sanskrit: प्रापतत्तच्च सहसा पाण्डवानां महद्बलम्। दधारैको रणे शल्यो वेलोवृत्तमिवार्णवम्॥५॥
verses.english: Shalya suddenly attacked the mighty army of the Pandavas. Alone he withstood it like the continent withstanding the surging deep.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवानां बलौघस्तु शल्यमासाद्य मारिष। व्यतिष्ठत तदा युद्धे सिन्धोर्वेग इवाचलम्॥६॥
verses.english: The huge army of the Pandavas, coming against Shalya, O sire, stood still in that battle, like the rushing deep upon being obstructed by a mountain.

verses.sanskrit: मद्रराजं तु समरे दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय धिष्ठितम्। कुरवः सन्न्यवर्तन्त मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥७॥
तेषु राजन् निवृत्तेषु व्यूढानीकेषु भागशः। प्रावर्तत महारौद्रः सङ्ग्रामः शोणितोदकः॥८॥
verses.english: After they had come back, O king and separately taken up their positions in a wellformed array, an awful encounter took place in which blood flowed freely like water. The invincible Nakula encountered Chitrasena.

verses.sanskrit: समार्छच्चित्रसेनं तु नकुलो युद्धदुर्मदः। तौ परस्परमासाद्य चित्रकार्मुकधारिणौ॥९॥
मोघाविव यथोद्वृत्तौ दक्षिणोत्तरवर्षिणौ। शरतोयैः सिषिचतुस्तौ परस्परमाहवे॥१०॥
verses.english: These two heroes, both excellent bowmen, approaching, covered each other with downpours of arrows in that battle, like two pouring clouds risen in the sky on the south and the north. I could mark no difference between the son of Pandu and his antagonist.

verses.sanskrit: नान्तरं तत्र पश्यामि पाण्डवस्येतरस्य च। उभौ कृतास्त्रौ बलिनौ रथचर्याविशारदौ॥११॥
परस्परवधे यत्तौ छिद्रान्वेषणतत्परौ। चित्रसेनस्तु भल्लेन पीतेन निशितेन च॥१२॥
verses.english: Both of them were masters of weapons, both very powerful and both were experienced car-warriors. Each determined upon killing the other, they carefully looked for each other's weak point.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलस्य महाराज मुष्टिदेशेऽच्छिनद्धनुः। अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं रुक्मपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः॥१३॥
verses.english: Then, O king, with a broad-headed arrow, well-tempered and sharp Chitrasena cut off Nakula's bow at the handle.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिः शरैरसम्भ्रान्तो ललाटे वै समार्पयत्। हयांश्चास्य शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः प्रेषयामास मृत्यवे॥१४॥
verses.english: Fearlessly then the son of Karna struck the bowless Nakula at the forehead with three gold-winged arrows whetted on stone.

verses.sanskrit: तथा ध्वजं सारथिं च त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरपातयत्। स शत्रुभुजनिर्मुक्तैर्ललाटस्थैस्त्रिभिः शरैः॥१५॥
verses.english: With a few more sharp arrows he killed Nakula's horses, Next he struck down both the standard and the driver of his antagonist, each with three arrows.

verses.sanskrit: नकुलः शुशुभे राजंस्त्रिशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः। स च्छिन्नधन्वा विरथः खड्गमादाय चर्म च॥१६॥
verses.english: With those three arrows shot off the arms of his foe and striking his forehead, Nakula, O king, looked beautiful like a mountain of three summits.

verses.sanskrit: रथादवातरद्वीरः शैलाग्रादिव केसरी। पद्भ्यामापततस्तस्य शरवृष्टिं समासृजत्॥१७॥
verses.english: Deprived of his bow and his car, the brave Nakula, taking up a sword, jumped down from his car like a lion from a mountain suminit.

verses.sanskrit: नुकलोऽप्यग्रसत्तां वै चर्मणा लघुविक्रमः। चित्रसेनरथं प्राप्य चित्रयोधी जितश्रमः॥१८॥
verses.english: As, however, he rushed on foot, his antagonist discharged a shower of arrows upon him. The highly active Nakula received that downpour of arrows on his shield.

verses.sanskrit: आरुरोह महाबाहुः सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः। सकुण्डलं समुकुटं सुमनसं स्वायतेक्षणम्॥१९॥
verses.english: Getting at the car of Chitrasena, the mightyarmed hero, the untiring son of Pandu, conversant with all modes of warfare, appeared before the troops.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेनशिरः कायादपाहरत पाण्डवः। स पपात रथोपस्थे दिवाकरसमद्युतिः॥२०॥
verses.english: The son of Pandu then cut off from Chitrasena's trunk his diadem-decked head, adorned with ear-rings and bedecked with a beautiful nose and a pair of large eyes. At this, Chitrasena, effulgent like the Sun, dropped down on the terrace of his car.

verses.sanskrit: चित्रसेनं विशस्तं तु दृष्ट्वा तत्र महारथाः। साधुवादस्वनांश्चक्रुः सिंहनादांश्च पुष्कलान्॥२१॥
verses.english: Beholding Chitrasena killed at the great carwarriors shouted there like lions and lauded him.

verses.sanskrit: विशस्तं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा कर्णपुत्रौ महारथौ। सुषेणः सत्यसेनश्च मुञ्चन्तौ विविधाशरान्॥२२॥
verses.english: Meanwhile, beholding their brother slain, the two sons of Karna, viz., Sushena and Satyasena, both of whom were great carwarriors, made a downpour of sharp arrows.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभ्यधावतां तूर्णं पाण्डवं रथिनां वरम्। जिघांसन्तौ यथा नागं व्याघ्रौ राजन्महावने॥२३॥
तावभ्यधावतां तीक्ष्णौ द्वावप्येनं महारथम्। शरौघान्सम्यगस्यन्तौ जीमूतौ सलिलं यथा॥२४॥
स शरैः सर्वतो विद्धः प्रहृष्ट इव पाण्डवः। अन्यत्कार्मुकमादाय रथमारुह्य वेगवान्॥२५॥
अतिष्ठत रणे वीरः क्रुद्धरूप इवान्तकः। तस्य तौ भ्रातरौ राजञ्शरैः सन्नतपर्वभिः॥२६॥
verses.english: Though wounded with arrows all over his body the valiant and heroic son of Pandu cheerfully took up another bow after getting upon another car and stood in battle like the angry Destroyers himself,

verses.sanskrit: रथं विशकलीकर्तुं समारब्धौ विशाम्पते। ततः प्रहस्य नकुलश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो रणे॥२७॥
verses.english: Then those two brothers, O kings, with their straight arrows, cut off Nakula's car into pieces.

verses.sanskrit: जघान निशितैर्बाणैः सत्यसेनस्य वाजिनः। ततः सन्धाय नाराचं रुक्मपुङ्ख शिलाशितम्॥२८॥
verses.english: Then Nakula, laughing, struck the four horses of Satyasena with four whetted and keen arrows in that encounter.

verses.sanskrit: धनुश्चिच्छेद राजेन्द्र सत्यसेनस्य पाण्डवः। अथान्यं रथमास्थाय धनुरादाय चापरम्॥२९॥
verses.english: Shooting a long gold-winged shaft the son of Pandu then cut off, O king, the bow of Satyasena.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यसेनः सुषेणश्च पाण्डवं पर्यधावताम्। अविध्यत्तावसम्भ्रान्तौ माद्रीपुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥३०॥
verses.english: At this the latter, mounting on another car and taking up another bow, as also his brother Sushena, rushed against the son of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां महाराज शराभ्यां रणमूर्धनि। सुषेणस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः पाण्डवस्य महद्धनुः॥३१॥
verses.english: The brave son of Madri fearlessly struck each of them, O monarch, with a couple of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद प्रहसन् युद्धे क्षुरप्रेण महारथः। अथान्यद्धनुरादाय नकुलः क्रोधमूर्छितः॥३२॥
verses.english: Then worked up with wrath, the mighty car-warrior Sushena, cut off, in that battle, the formidable bow of Pandu's son with a razorshaped arrow.

verses.sanskrit: सुषेणं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा ध्वजमेकेन चिच्छिदे। सत्यसेनस्य च धनुर्हस्तावापं च मारिष॥३३॥
verses.english: Then Nakula, beside himself with rage, took up another bow and struck Sushena with five arrows and his standard with one.

verses.sanskrit: चिच्छेद तरसा युद्धे तत उच्चुक्रुशुर्जनाः। अथान्यद्धनुरादाय वेगघ्नं भारसाधनम्॥३४॥
verses.english: Without losing a moment, he then cut off the boy and the leathern fence of Saryasena also, at which all the troops there sent up a loud shout.

verses.sanskrit: शरैः सञ्छादयामास समन्तात्पाण्डुनन्दनम्। सन्निवार्य तु तान्बाणान्नकुलः परवीरहा॥३५॥
verses.english: Satyasena, taking up another foe-slaying and powerful bow, covered the son of Pandu with arrows on all sides.

verses.sanskrit: सत्यसेनं सुषेणं च द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यामविध्यत। तावेनं प्रत्यविध्येतां पृथक् पृथगजिह्मगैः॥३६॥
verses.english: Baffling those arrows Nakula, that slayer of hostile heroes, struck each of his antagonists with a couple of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: सारथिं चास्य राजेन्द्र शितैर्विव्यधतुः शरैः। सत्यसेनो रथेषां तु नकुलस्य धनुस्तथा॥३७॥
verses.english: Each of the latter separately struck the son of Pandu in return with ma..y straight coursing arrows. Afterwards they struck Nakula's driver also with many keen arrows.

verses.sanskrit: पृथक्छराभ्यां चिच्छेद कृतहस्तः प्रतापवान्। स रथेऽतिरथस्तिष्ठन् रथशक्तिं परामृशत्॥३८॥
verses.english: The brave and light-handed Satyasena then cut off without his brother's help the shafts of Nakula's car and his bow with a couple of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: स्वर्णदण्डामकुण्ठाग्रां तैलधौतां सुनिर्मलाम्। लेलिहानामिव विभो नागकन्यां महाविषाम्॥३९॥
verses.english: The great car warrior Nakula, however, standing on his car, took up a golden mounted and keen dart steeped in oil and exceedingly bright.

verses.sanskrit: समुद्यम्य च चिक्षेप सत्यसेनस्य संयुगे। सा तस्य हृदयं सङ्ख्ये बिभेद च तथा नृप॥४०॥
verses.english: It resembled, O king, a she-snake of dreadful poison, frequently darting out her tongue. Raising that weapon he hurled it at Satyasena in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: स पपात रथाद्भूमिं गतसत्त्वोऽल्पचेतनः। भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा सुषेणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः॥४१॥
verses.english: That dart, O king, cut the heart of Satyasena in that battle into a hundred pieces and he fell down dead upon the Earth from his car.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्यवर्षच्छरैस्तूर्णं पादातं पाण्डुनन्दनम्। चतुर्भिश्चतुरो वाहान् ध्वजं छित्वा च पञ्चभिः॥४२॥
verses.english: Beholding his brother killed Sushena, beside himself with rage, suddenly made Nakula careless in that battle. Without losing a moment, he poured arrows over the son of Pandu fighting on foot. He pierced four arrows and destroyed his four cars. Again he pierced five and cut off his flag. Then by three the son of Karna killed charioteer and uttered a loud leonine roar.

verses.sanskrit: त्रिभिर्वै सारथिं हत्वा कर्णपुत्रो ननाद ह। नकुलं विरथं दृष्ट्वा द्रौपदेयो महारथम्॥४३॥
सुतसोमोऽभिदुद्राव परीप्सन् पितरं रणे। ततोऽधिरुह्य नुकलः सुतसोमस्य तं रथम्॥४४॥
verses.english: Seeing Nakula carless, the mighty carwarrior Sutasoma, the son of Draupadi rushed, there for rescuing his father in battle.

verses.sanskrit: शुशुभे भरतश्रेष्ठो गिरिस्थ इव केसरी। अन्यत्कार्मुकमादाय सुषेणं समयोधयत्॥४५॥
verses.english: Riding then the car of Sutasoma, Nakula, that hero of Bharata's race, looked beautiful like a lion upon a mountain. Then taking up another bow, he fought with Sushena.

verses.sanskrit: तावुभौ शरवर्षाभ्यां समासाद्य परस्परम्। परस्परवधे यत्नं चक्रतुः सुमहारथौ॥४६॥
verses.english: Those two great car-warriors, approaching each other and discharging arrows, tried to kill each other.

verses.sanskrit: सुषेणस्तु ततः क्रुद्धः पाण्डवं विशिखैस्त्रिभिः। सुतसोमं तु विंशत्या बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥४७॥
ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज नकुलः परवीरहा। शरैस्तस्य दिशः सर्वाश्छादयामास वीर्यवान्॥४८॥
verses.english: At this the impetuous Nakula, O king, that slayer of hostile heroes, covered all the points of the compass with shafts.

verses.sanskrit: ततो गृहीत्वा तीक्ष्णाग्रमर्धचन्द्रं सुतेजनम्। सुवेगवन्तं चिक्षेप कर्णपुत्राय संयुगे॥४९॥
verses.english: Then taking up a sharp and powerful arrow having a semi-circular head, Nakula shot it with great force at Karna's son in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तेन शिरः कायाज्जहार नृपसत्तम। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥५०॥
स हतः प्रापतद्राजन्नकुलेन महात्मना। नदीवेगादिवारुग्णस्तीरजः पादपो महान्॥५१॥
verses.english: Thus killed by the illustrious Nakula Karna's son drooped down like a tall tree on the bank of a river thrown down by the current of the river.

verses.sanskrit: कर्णपुत्रवधं दृष्ट्वा नकुलस्य च विक्रमम्। प्रदुद्राव भयात्सेना तावकी भरतर्षभ॥५२॥
verses.english: Seeing the destruction of Karna's son and the power of Nakula, your army, O best of Bharatas, fled away in fear.

verses.sanskrit: तां तु सेनां महाराज मद्रराजः प्रतापवान्। अपालयद्रणे शूरः सेनापतिररिन्दमः॥५३॥
विभीस्तस्थौ महाराज व्यवस्थाप्य च वाहिनीम्। सिंहनादं भृशं कृत्वा धनुःशब्दं च दारुणम्॥५४॥
verses.english: Rallying his army, O king, Shalya stood fearlessly in battle sending forth leonine shouts and twanging his bow fiercely.

verses.sanskrit: तावकाः समरे राजन् रक्षिता दृढधन्वना। प्रत्युद्ययुश्च तांस्ते तु समन्ताद्विगतव्यथाः॥५५॥
verses.english: Then your soldiers O king, protected in battle by that firm bowman, cheerfully rushed against the enemy once more from all sides.

verses.sanskrit: मद्रराजं महेष्वासं परिवार्य समन्ततः। स्थिता राजन्महासेना योद्धुकामा समन्ततः॥५६॥
verses.english: Those great warriors, encircling that great bowmen, the king of the Madras, stood, O king, desirous of fighting on every side.

verses.sanskrit: सात्यकिर्भीमसेनश्च माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ। युधिष्ठिरं पुरस्कृत्य ह्रीनिषेवमरिन्दमम्॥५७॥
verses.english: Then Satyaki and Bhimasena and those two Pandavas, the twin sons of Madri, placing that modest chastiser of foes, Yudhishthira, at their head and surrounding him on all sides in that battle, sent up leonine roars. And those heroes also caused a loud sound of the arrows and frequently sent up war-cries.

verses.sanskrit: परिवार्य रणे वीराः सिंहनादं प्रचक्रिरे। बाणशङ्खरवांस्तीव्रान् क्ष्वेडाश्च विविधा दधुः॥५८॥
तथैव तावकाः सर्वे मद्राधिपतिमञ्जसा। परिवार्य सुसंरब्धाः पुनयुद्धमरोचयन्॥५९॥
verses.english: Smingly, all your warriors, enraged, quickly encompassed the king of the Madras and stood there for battle.

verses.sanskrit: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं भीरूणां भयवर्धनम्। तावकानां परेषां च मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥६०॥
यथा देवासुरं युद्धं पूर्वमासीद्विशाम्पते। अभीतानां तथा राजन् यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्॥६१॥
verses.english: The battle between fearless combatants resembled, O king that between the gods and the Asuras in days of yore and increased the population of Yama's kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: ततः कपिध्वजो राजन्हत्वा संशप्तकान् रणे। अभ्यद्रवत तां सेनां कौरवीं पाण्डुनन्दनः॥६२॥
verses.english: Then the ape-emblemed son of Pandu, O king, having killed the Samsaptakas in battle, rushed against the Kauravas.

verses.sanskrit: तथैव पाण्डवाः सर्वे धृष्टद्युम्नपरोगमाः। अभ्यधावन्त तां सेनां विसृजन्तः शिताञ्शरान्॥६३॥
verses.english: Smiling, all the Pandavas, headed by Dhrishtadyumna, proceeded against the same detachment discharging keen arrows.

verses.sanskrit: पाण्डवैरवकीर्णानां सम्मोहः समजायत। न च जज्ञुस्त्वनीकानि दिशो वा विदिशस्तथा॥६४॥
आपूर्यमाणा निशितैः शरैः पाण्डवचोदितैः। हतप्रवीरा विध्वस्ता वार्यमाणा समन्ततः॥६५॥
verses.english: Covered with keen arrows shot by the Pandavas, the Kaurava ariny, deprived of its foremost warriors, were routed on all sides. Indeed, O Kauravya, your army were killed by the mighty car-warriors of the Pandavas.

verses.sanskrit: कौरव्यवध्यत चमूः पाण्डुपुत्रैर्महारथैः। तथैव पाण्डवं सैन्यं शरै राजन्समन्ततः॥६६॥
रणेऽहन्यत पुत्रैस्ते शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। ते सेने भृशसन्तप्ते वध्यमाने परस्परम्॥६७॥
verses.english: Similarly, the Pandava army, O king, were killed in hundreds and thousands in that battle by your sons on every side with their arrows.

verses.sanskrit: व्याकुले समपद्येतां वर्षासु सरिताविव। आविवेश ततस्तीव्रं तावकानां महद्भयम्। पाण्डवानां च राजेन्द्र तथाभूते महाहवे॥६८॥
